title: My English Book 10
header: Builds "My English Book 10" – tenth-grade English syllabus – A4 portrait.
csub: Past perfect • If I had … • I wish • Linking words • Stories
noteP: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ يُكْمِلُ تَعْلِيمَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ: المَاضِي التَّامُّ، وَالشَّرْطُ فِي المَاضِي، وَالتَّمَنِّي بِـ wish، وَأَدَوَاتُ الرَّبْطِ، وَالمُسْتَقْبَلُ المُسْتَمِرُّ، وَتَكْوِينُ الكَلِمَاتِ، مَعَ قِصَّتَيْنِ 🇬🇧
noteLi: فِي كُلِّ دَرْسٍ بِطَاقَةٌ لِيَكْتُبَ طِفْلُكُمْ جُمْلَةً إِنْجِلِيزِيَّةً مِنْ عِنْدِهِ.
اسْأَلُوهُ: What will you be doing this time tomorrow?
اطْلُبُوا مِنْهُ ثَلَاثَ أُمْنِيَاتٍ: I wish …
فِي المَهَمَّاتِ يُظَلِّلُ حَرْفَ الإِجَابَةِ فِي وَرَقَةِ الإِجَابَةِ، وَالكِتَابُ يُقْرَأُ مِنَ اليَسَارِ إِلَى اليَمِينِ.

units.title: Past Perfect
units.intro: We use had + past participle for an action that happened before another action in the past.
items: When we arrived at the station, the train had already left.
The film had started when I sat down.
I had finished my homework before my friend called.
She had eaten before she went out.
After he had prayed, he read the Quran.
Before I went to bed, I had brushed my teeth.

acts.title: Choose the right form
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: When I got home, my family ... dinner.
She was sad because she ... her keys.
We ... the museum before, so we knew the way.
By the time the teacher came, we ... the test.

acts.title: Which happened first?
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: When I arrived, the bus had left.
He had studied hard, so he passed.
After she had cooked, she cleaned the kitchen.
I had never seen snow before I visited Abha.

units.title: Third Conditional
units.intro: We use If + had + past participle, … would have + past participle to talk about imaginary past situations.
items: If I had known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If she had studied, she would have passed the exam.
If it hadn't rained, we would have played outside.

acts.title: Choose the right form
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: If I had woken up early, I ... the bus.
If he ... harder, he would have won.
We would have helped you if you ... us.
If they had left earlier, they ... late.

acts.title: What really happened?
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: If I had seen him, I would have said hello.
If it had been sunny, we would have gone to the beach.
If she had remembered, she would have called.
If we had had time, we would have visited you.

units.title: I wish …
units.intro: We use wish + past simple for wishes about the present, and wish + past perfect for regrets about the past.
items: I wish I had a bike.
I don't have a bike now.
I wish I were at the beach now.
I am not at the beach.
I wish I had studied harder last year.
I didn't study hard. I regret it.

acts.title: Choose the right form
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: I wish I ... to the party yesterday.

acts.title: What does it mean?
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: I wish I knew the answer.
I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
She wishes she lived near the sea.
She doesn't live near the sea.
I wish I had listened to my mother.

units.title: Linking Words
units.intro: Linking words join ideas. We use although for contrast, because for reasons, and so for results.
items: Although it was raining, we went to the mosque.
Although he was tired, he finished his work.
The book was long. However, it was very interesting.
I was tired, so I went to bed early.

acts.title: Choose the linking word
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: ... it was cold, he didn't wear a coat.
She studied hard, ... she got full marks.
I stayed at home ... I was ill.
The test was hard. ..., everyone passed.

units.title: Future Continuous
units.intro: We use will be + verb-ing for an action that will be in progress at a time in the future.
items: This time tomorrow, I will be flying to Jeddah.
At 8 p.m. tonight, I will be studying for the test.
Will you be using your laptop this evening?
Yes, I will. / No, I won't.

acts.title: Choose the right form
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: At ten tomorrow, we ... a test.
Don't call at seven. I ... dinner.
This time next week, they ... in Makkah.

acts.title: Choose the correct sentence
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: Tomorrow at 9, I will be sleeping.
Next Monday, she will be travelling.
Tonight, we will be watching the match.
In an hour, my mother cooked.
In an hour, my mother will be cooking.

units.title: Word Formation
units.intro: We add prefixes and suffixes to make new words: un- means not, -ful means full of, and -less means without.
items: The test was unfair. (= not fair)
It is impossible to read in the dark.

acts.title: Choose the right word
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: Be ... when you cross the road.
He didn't eat all day. He was very ...
I can't open this door. It's ...

units.intro: Read the stories, then answer the questions.

acts.title: The Volunteer Club
acts.html:
The Volunteer Club 🤝

Last year, Faisal joined the school volunteer club.
Before he joined, he had never helped in a hospital.
Although the work was hard, he enjoyed it.
He says, “I wish I had joined earlier.”
Next summer, he will be helping at the children's hospital again.

acts.title: Answer
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: Had he helped in a hospital before?
What will he be doing next summer?

acts.title: The Birthday Cake
acts.html:
The Birthday Cake 🎂

Noura wanted to bake a cake for her mother's birthday.
When she started, she realised she had forgotten to buy eggs.
If she had checked the kitchen, she would have bought them.
However, her neighbour kindly gave her some eggs, so the cake was ready on time.

acts.title: Answer
acts.hint: Read the question, then shade the letter of the correct answer on the answer sheet
rows: Why did Noura bake a cake?
What would she have done if she had checked the kitchen?
